skill.description: Guides Seedance 2.0 video creation from concept to storyboard, reference assets, task submission, and result polling through MCP or a Python helper.

skill.author: hexiaochun

security_audit.summary: The skill performs expected third-party Seedance/XSkill API calls and uses an environment API key. Most Markdown backtick, task_id, and entropy findings are false positives, but the audit confirmed credential exposure guidance, bearer-token handling with a configurable base URL, unpinned package installation, and local file upload risk.

remediation.issue: The setup instructions print the first characters of XSKILL_API_KEY.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the echo command with a non-disclosing presence check, and never print any part of the API key.

remediation.issue: XSKILL_BASE_URL can redirect authenticated API requests.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the override by default, or validate it against a strict allowlist before sending the Authorization header.

remediation.issue: The upload command can read and send any path passed as --image-path.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation, validate image MIME type and size, and reject hidden or sensitive system paths.

remediation.issue: The dependency installation guidance uses an unpinned pip install command.
remediation.suggestion: Provide a pinned requirements file and recommend a virtual environment with a trusted package index.

semantic_findings.title: API Key Prefix Disclosure Guidance
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md instructs the agent to verify XSKILL_API_KEY by printing the first ten characters. This can expose sensitive credential material in terminal output, logs, or shared transcripts.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exact command prints part of the API key, and the line is an operational instruction rather than a harmless placeholder.

semantic_findings.title: Configurable Base URL Can Redirect Bearer Token
semantic_findings.description: scripts/seedance_api.py builds API endpoints from XSKILL_BASE_URL and sends XSKILL_API_KEY in the Authorization header. An untrusted base URL can receive the bearer token.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly combines an environment-controlled base URL with a bearer Authorization header. Legitimate override use is possible, but the credential redirection path is clear.

semantic_findings.title: Local File Upload Can Exfiltrate Arbitrary Paths
semantic_findings.description: The upload command accepts --image-path, reads that local file, base64 encodes it, and posts it to the upload endpoint. A malicious prompt could request a sensitive path unless the agent confirms the file and type.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file read and upload are explicit in the helper script. The risk depends on user or agent path choice, so medium severity is appropriate.

content.value_statement: AI video workflows need clear prompts, assets, and status tracking. This skill guides storyboard planning and submits Seedance tasks through MCP or Python.
actual_capabilities: Builds structured video storyboards with timing, camera movement, visuals, audio, and asset references.
Generates reference image task plans for Seedream 4.5 text-to-image and edit models.
Submits Seedance 2.0 video tasks through MCP tools or the bundled Python script.
Polls image and video task status until completion, failure, or timeout.
Uploads image URLs or local image files for use as video references.
Checks XSkill account balance through the API helper.
limitations: Requires an XSkill API key and network access to the configured API endpoint.
Generated quality, runtime, pricing, and availability depend on the external service.
Local file upload must be limited to intended image files selected by the user.
The helper does not validate every model parameter before submitting tasks.

use_cases.title: Plan Short Social Videos
use_cases.description: Turn a brief creative idea into a timed storyboard and Seedance prompt for a short AI video.

use_cases.title: Create Product Motion Concepts
use_cases.description: Draft product reveal scenes, reference images, and camera directions for fast visual exploration.

use_cases.title: Automate Video Task Submission
use_cases.description: Use MCP or the Python helper to submit tasks, poll status, and retrieve finished media links.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Video Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a simple text-to-video request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use seedance2-api to create a 6 second 16:9 video idea about a calm sunrise over a modern city. Build the storyboard and submit it if the API is ready.

prompt_templates.title: Storyboard With Style
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt that defines timing, mood, and camera direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10 second vertical AI video storyboard for a new running shoe. Use energetic lighting, close product details, and a final brand reveal.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Asset Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt that asks for reference images before video generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate reference image prompts for a sci-fi explorer and alien desert scene, then use them to prepare a Seedance 2.0 video task.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Multimodal Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for existing image, video, and audio references.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my provided image, short motion reference, and audio reference to make a 15 second cinematic video. Keep references ordered and poll until the result is ready.

output_examples.input: Create a 10 second product reveal for a premium coffee cup.
output: A timed storyboard with close-up steam, hand interaction, product rotation, and final brand frame.
A reference image plan for cup material, morning light, and background setting.
A task status summary with the generated media link when the video completes.

output_examples.input: Make an astronaut walking on Mars in a cinematic style.
output: A 15 second scene plan with camera movement, subject motion, atmosphere, and audio direction.
Seedream reference image prompts for the astronaut and Martian environment.
A Seedance task submission and polling update until completion or failure.

output_examples.input: Extend this short clip by keeping the same character and motion style.
output_examples.output: A continuation storyboard that preserves the original subject, movement, color tone, and pacing before submitting the new video task.

best_practices: Confirm duration, aspect ratio, visual style, and reference assets before submission.
Use consistent names and ordering for image, video, and audio references.
Review local file paths with the user before uploading any file.
anti_patterns: Do not print API keys or partial API keys in terminal output.
Do not submit vague prompts without timing, camera, motion, and asset details.
Do not upload local files unless the user explicitly selected them for the video.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs XSKILL_API_KEY for task submission, polling, uploads, and balance checks.

faq.question: Can it work without MCP tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a Python helper script for submit, query, poll, balance, and upload commands.

faq.question: What video lengths are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents Seedance 2.0 durations from 4 to 15 seconds, depending on model parameters.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports image references, first and last frames, and Seedream image generation workflows.

faq.question: Does it store generated videos locally?
faq.answer: No. The helper prints API results and media URLs returned by the external service.

faq.question: What should users check before uploading files?
faq.answer: Users should confirm the file path, file type, and that the image contains no sensitive content.
